assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET. Input image is APPROVED CHARACTER IDENTITY and drawing STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Render exactly the same middle-aged stocky male bathroom cashier with receding dark hair and grey temples, small moustache, grey-blue rolled-sleeve work jacket over beige shirt, short brown canvas waist apron with pen and ledger pocket, brass keyring, charcoal trousers and dark rounded work shoes. Crisp dark cartoon outlines, clean cel shading, short chibi proportions identical to reference, no realism. ONE horizontal row of THREE equal-size full-body poses, generously separated into equal thirds of canvas, feet on same baseline, head tops aligned, all poses same scale and facing slightly screen-right at the game's elevated orthographic three-quarter view. LEFT idle relaxed hands; MIDDLE holding small ledger and pen, writing a cash transaction; RIGHT handing a small teal-blue water card toward screen-right. Complete body including shoes in each cell. No cropped hands. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, NO paper, labels, headings, frame, floor, ground shadow, decorative studies, other people, counter or props outside hands. Output only the three character poses, consistent identity and scale. This stationary service NPC will use these idle and transaction poses.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production 2D inventory icon on TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Input image is APPROVED WATER-CARD DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Render ONLY the FRONT face of the exact muted teal grey-blue prepaid bath water card from the top-left reference panel, horizontal rounded rectangle ratio1.65:1, gently worn edges and corner rivet-like marks, cream printed label on right, outlined white water-drop symbol on left. Exact large text "公共浴室" and "水卡". Crisp readable hand-painted outlines, subdued old Chinese factory game material, slight controlled ageing, calm broad color areas. Flat front-on orthographic card, no perspective, no rotation, no back view, chip diagram, hand, coin, reader, machine, counter, UI, background, caption or shadow. One card occupies roughly80% canvas width with transparent margins. Prioritize the silhouette and water-drop mark readable as a small backpack icon, not noisy texture.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production 2D scene prop sprite, TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Input is APPROVED COUNTER STYLE AND SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY: recreate the small wood-topped grey-blue painted metal WATER-CARD RECHARGE COUNTER, thin aged wood tabletop, two drawers, small key lock, four short legs, cream enamel front sign exactly "水卡充值". Tabletop holds a small open handwritten ledger, one pen, few coins and one small muted teal water card. Absolutely NO electronic reader, screen, scanner, terminal or other machine. NO character or hands. Game camera elevated orthographic top-down 2D with visible tabletop and modest front face, perfectly horizontal front/top edges and vertical sides, no isometric diamond, no vanishing-point convergence. Similar proportion width:complete-sprite-height about1.3:1, compact narrow service counter as in the approved scene, no long reception desk. Crisp hand-painted fine edges, soft diffuse light from upper-left, restrained wear, subdued color, matches aqua bath tiles and factory props. Isolated entire object including feet, transparent margin, no floor plate, cast ground shadow, bath tile wall, scene, graphic board or annotations beyond the physical sign.
